name: Can I renovate my plumbing myself to save money?

mainEntity.name: Can I renovate my plumbing myself to save money?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some minor plumbing tasks can be DIY, significant renovation plumbing like relocating pipes, installing new water lines, or altering drainage systems should ideally be handled by licensed professionals. Improperly installed plumbing can lead to costly leaks, water damage, health hazards, and may not pass local inspections. As a decision factor, hiring a professional ensures work complies with local codes, like those in Las Vegas, and is often covered by warranties, providing peace of mind and avoiding future issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Major plumbing renovations should be done by licensed professionals to ensure code compliance, prevent costly issues, and ensure proper functionality. DIY can lead to expensive mistakes.
